# Cong Le Apps

> Indie iOS apps by Cong Le — utilities, family, fishing, AI chat, and games. The canonical app catalogue and download links are below; practical guides live on the blog.

The [full machine-readable catalogue](https://www.cong-le.com/llms-full.txt) includes every app landing page, App Store link, available language page, and published article.

## Apps

- [Ollama Connect](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/ollama-connect/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6769891596?ct=congle-web-ollama-connect&pt=19678800)): Ollama Connect is a private chat client for Ollama on iPhone. Connect to Ollama running on your Mac, home server, or private endpoint and chat with your models. Chats and settings stay on your device.
- [Baby Screen Lock: Kid Safe](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/baby-screen-lock/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761378897?ct=congle-web-baby-screen-lock&pt=19678800)): Baby Screen Lock keeps your little one entertained with 33 age-appropriate interactive games while locking the screen so they can't accidentally call, delete photos, or exit. Includes a parent lock, session timer, and offline play.
- [Hoop Quest: Basketball Sim](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/hoop-quest/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775279715?ct=congle-web-hoop-quest&pt=19678800)): Hoop Quest: Basketball Sim is a retro player-career RPG. Build a fictional basketball career from backyard prospect to all-time legend with live games, ratings, roster context, and long-term legacy. All teams, players, and leagues are fictional.
- [Solunar: Best Fishing Times](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/solunar-fishing/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760960543?ct=congle-web-solunar-fishing&pt=19678800)): Solunar Fishing Times uses proven solunar theory to predict major and minor feeding windows based on the moon's position — no internet or weather API required. A clean 1-5 daily fish rating tells you at a glance whether today is worth the trip.
- [Anniversary Tracker](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/anniversary-tracker/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1570714816?ct=congle-web-anniversary-tracker&pt=19678800)): Anniversary Tracker helps you count, customise, and never forget the moments that matter most — from your very first day together to your 10,000th. Includes an automatic day counter, smart reminders, and built-in milestones.
- [Age Calculator: How Old Am I](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/age-calculator-how-old-am-i/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6770217651?ct=congle-web-age-calculator-how-old-am-i&pt=19678800)): Age Calculator helps you see your age clearly, not approximately.

- [Baby Names: Swipe & Pick](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/baby-names/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760255587?ct=congle-web-baby-names&pt=19678800)): Swipe through 20,000+ baby names from 33 cultures. Match with your partner and find names you both love.

Features daily KJV verse, morning and evening prayer check-ins. 100% offline, no accounts, no analytics.
- [BingeFree: Recovery Companion](https://www.cong-le.com/apps/bingefree-recovery-companion/) ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6797020508?ct=congle-web-bingefree-recovery-companion&pt=19678800)): BingeFree is a calm, mascot-guided companion for binge eating recovery — built around AVRT (Addictive Voice Recognition Technique), not diet culture.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/)
- [CloudKit Rejects @Attribute(.unique) — Model Around It](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/swiftdata-cloudkit-rejects-unique-attribute/): SwiftData's unique constraint is incompatible with CloudKit sync. Why there's no workaround, and how to enforce uniqueness without it.
- [SwiftData's String SortDescriptor Isn't Sorting How You Think](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/swiftdata-sortdescriptor-string-localized-standard/): A SortDescriptor on a String key path defaults to .localizedStandard, which is numeric-aware and locale-dependent — so it disagrees with Swift's < and changes per user.
- [What Locales We Translate To, and Why](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/what-locales-we-translate-to-and-why/): Four languages are non-negotiable, another fifteen are nearly free, and English-only leaves most of the App Store unreachable. The reasoning behind the list.
- [We Translate Every String As We Write It](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/we-translate-every-string-as-we-write-it/): Why retrofitting localisation into an iOS app always leaks, and the SwiftUI patterns that silently break translation without warning you.
- [Every SwiftData Property Needs a Default Value](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/swiftdata-properties-need-default-values/): If you use SwiftData with CloudKit and a property has no default, the store fails silently and every fetch returns empty. Here's why, and the fix.
- [Guided Access on iPhone: Complete Guide (and Its Limits)](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/guided-access-iphone-baby/): A complete Guided Access iPhone guide for parents: how to set it up, use it with a baby or toddler, and where it falls short.
- [Solunar Theory Explained: Does Fishing by the Moon Actually Work?](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/solunar-theory-explained/): Solunar theory explained: where it came from, why the moon affects fish feeding, and how much you should really trust solunar tables.
- [How to Never Forget an Anniversary Again](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/how-to-never-forget-an-anniversary-again/): Never forget an anniversary again: build a reliable system with calendars, layered reminders, and widgets that put the date in front of you.
- [Best Basketball Career Simulator Games for iPhone](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/best-basketball-career-simulator-games-iphone/): A basketball career sim iOS roundup: what makes a great player-career RPG on iPhone and why Hoop Quest earns a spot.
- [AI Chat Apps Without Filters: What to Look For](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/ai-chat-apps-without-filters-what-to-look-for/): What 'uncensored' AI chat really means, why mainstream assistants refuse things, and the privacy features that matter when choosing an unfiltered chat app.
- [What Is the Best Time to Fish Today?](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/best-time-to-fish-today/): Find the best time to fish today using major and minor feeding windows, moon position, and a simple daily rating anglers actually trust.
- [How to Chat with Ollama from Your iPhone](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/how-to-chat-with-ollama-from-your-iphone/): Set up an Ollama iPhone client in minutes: run Ollama on your Mac or PC, expose it on your network, and chat with your local models on the go.
- [How to Lock Your iPhone Screen for a Baby](https://www.cong-le.com/blog/lock-iphone-screen-for-baby/): Learn how to lock your iPhone screen for a baby using Guided Access, plus a faster app-based alternative that keeps little fingers from causing chaos.
